messages:
Lizzy Mendoza: Quick company-wide hiring update: we have approval to accelerate a Q2 hiring surge focused on Platform (runtime, capacity, and observability). This is to support Dedicated capacity commitments and Private deployment ramp. Hiring velocity matters here  please follow the fast-track process below.

Steps (short):
1) Hiring managers: update reqs in Greenhouse and tag "Q2-surge".
2) Recruiting: prioritize senior runtime eng, infra PM, 2 senior SREs, and 1 product designer for console flows.
3) People Ops: we'll do centralized interview calibration sessions and fast-track approvals.

Nora Elbaz: Thanks Lizzy. Recruitings flagging that we need standardized interview scorecards for runtime and capacity roles  can Eng/PM leads share templates by EOD?

Evan Carter: I'll post templates to the hiring drive and add a short rubric for infra PM vs. product PM. Also recommend a 2-step loop for senior hires (technical + leadership).

Samir Patel: Heads up  candidate pipeline for runtime is strong but slow on offer approvals last round. Can we reuse the executive fast-track sign-off we used in March?

Lizzy Mendoza: Yes. We'll reuse the March fast-track. I've enabled a 'Fast-Approve' tag that routes offers to Alex Gomez and Priya Natarajan for 48-hour turnaround. If you need <48h, escalate to me directly.

Priya Natarajan: Quick note on interview panels: for SREs please include an oncall owner and an infra architect. We found missing context in previous loops.

HiringBot: Interview calibration session created: Tue 11:00 AM. Attendees: Hiring leads, Recruiting, Eng reps.

Nora Elbaz: For Private deployments hires, Mariam Okoye asked that compliance and KMS experience be listed as preferred, not required. This reduces false negatives from cloud-only candidates.

Evan Carter: Good call. Also adding a short technical take-home for runtime engs that focuses on KV cache invalidation patterns and batching tradeoffs (15-30 minutes).

Samir Patel: I'll update job postings and ping active candidates. Expect two on-site loops next week.

Lizzy Mendoza: Reminder: please add interview debriefs to the candidate card within 24 hours. We'll pull metrics weekly.

Priya Natarajan: Will there be any temporary reassignments while we hire? We might need a few contractors for capacity planning workstreams.

Lizzy Mendoza: Yes, contracting OK for up to 3 months. Submit contractor reqs with justification and expected ramp time. We'll prioritize those with onboarding docs ready.

Evan Carter: 44d sending templates now.

Nora Elbaz: Appreciate the speed here. One ask: can we get a single tracking doc for visibility across Eng/People Ops/Recruiting?

Lizzy Mendoza: Done  shared tracker: https://redwood.in/ops/q2-hiring-surge (internal). I've granted edit rights to hiring managers and recruiting.

Samir Patel: Thanks. I'll start outreach.

Lizzy Mendoza: Thanks team. Let's keep comms in this thread for blockers only; daily standups will be via the hiring tracker updates. :rocket:
